name: Definitive Residence (RD-1)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires having legally resided in the country for 10 years or more as a Permanent Resident (RP-1 holder).
requirements.fix_path: Hold Permanent Residence continuously for 10 years.

evidence_required.document: Current Permanent Residence Card (original and copy)
Criminal record certificate from the Attorney General's Office with QR code

outcome.duration_length: Indefinite (described by DGM as a 10-year extension of the residence permit)

sources.title: Dirección General de Migración -- Definitive Residence (RD-1): 10 years as Permanent Resident required, RD$28,000 fee, 30 working days

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Dominican Republic). leads_to_citizenship modeled false here: this is a status upgrade for long-term Permanent Residents, not itself a citizenship pathway -- Ordinary Naturalization is already reachable 2 years after RP-1 (see do_naturalisation.json), well before the 10-year RD-1 mark, so RD-1 is not on the practical path to citizenship for someone pursuing naturalization. DGM's own page frames RD-1 as essentially 'an extension of the residence permit for an additional ten (10) years' rather than a distinct legal status with new rights -- modeled work/study rights as unchanged from RP-1 accordingly.
